description: Hello ! We're just a binch of teens trying to do their best !
summary: we developped a video game about differents spatial wrecks of differents martian missions. The objective was to make something accessible, as much for adults and passionate students who work in the spatial field as for childs, teens and people who has less competencies and who just want to discover more about traces missions left on mars. It offers an approach very fun and playful to be able to reach a public as broad as possible. But it is also a real documentary with informations about the missions that have led to these wrecks.
details: it's a game with 4 mini games based on the initial missionsof each spatial wreck. its is playful ans so really accessible for everyone but it is also documented with each mission having it's description page. we used ai to create the code ( html,css, java script ). we thought about the fact that the history of these wrecks might interest people of all ages so we wanted to make something that makes you want to learn so we mmade a video game.
